en: The front of the postcard features an old hand-tinted photograph of a harbor, with several wooden ships docked and a town with distinct European architecture set against a hilly, forested landscape. Prominent text at the top left reads 'Sundsvalls hamn.' Additional handwritten script is visible. The reverse side is a classic divided-back format, with printed instructions in Swedish and French, and handwritten greetings in Swedish.
